name: alternate-dumbbell-bench-press-high-start.html
instructions:
1. Pick up the dumbbells off the floor using a neutral grip (palms facing in). Position the ends of the dumbbells in your hip crease, and sit down on the bench.
2. To get into position, lay back and keep the weights close to your chest. Once you are in position, take a deep breath, and press the dumbbells to lockout at the top.
3. Slowly lower one dumbbell under control as far as comfortably possible (the handle should be about level with your chest) while keeping the other locked out at the top.
4. Contract the chest and push the dumbbell back up to the starting position.
5. Slowly lower the other dumbbell under control as far as comfortably possible (the handle should be about level with your chest) while keeping the other locked out at the top.
6. Repeat for the desired number of repetitions.
